description: This PHP class models an employee's emergency contact information within the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations. It includes properties for contact details and relationships to an Employee entity.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContact
classes.description: Entity representing an employee's emergency contact, mapped to the 'hs_hr_emp_emergency_contacts' database table with properties for contact details and relations.

methods.name: getDecorator
methods.description: Returns the decorator object for this entity, as specified by the @method annotation.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence number for the emergency contact.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number for the emergency contact.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the name of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the emergency contact.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Gets the relationship of the emergency contact to the employee.

methods.name: setRelationship
methods.description: Sets the relationship of the emergency contact to the employee.

methods.name: getHomePhone
methods.description: Gets the home phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setHomePhone
methods.description: Sets the home phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: getMobilePhone
methods.description: Gets the mobile phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setMobilePhone
methods.description: Sets the mobile phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: getOfficePhone
methods.description: Gets the office phone number of the emergency contact.

methods.name: setOfficePhone
methods.description: Sets the office phone number of the emergency contact.
